post.description: Normalize client intent under this contract revision, then authorize and resolve principal+project+kind+client_operation_id/key before new uploads or mutable native-v1 config resolution. Same canonical request returns original IDs and frozen config even after alias changes. Bind new key alias atomically; changed input conflicts. Freeze separate config/envelope for a new operation. Ambiguous commit returns outcome_uncertain; retain original principal and identities. Admission is not provider dispatch; total validation budget authorization is separate from the 200000000 microUSD per-job schema ceiling.

post.description: Queued jobs become cancelled; running jobs record intent. Terminal jobs retain their terminal state. No promise to cancel a dispatched provider request or refund its reservation.

TaskDefinition.title: TaskDefinition
TaskDefinition.description: Existing TaskSpec fields without budget_usd/seed. Preserve current semantic validation: normalized paths, disjoint source/evaluator paths, at most 2,000 initial files, 8 MiB manifest limit, and redaction pattern length 120. These cross-field rules are not all expressible by this schema.

adapter_config_id.description: M1 supports the administrator-configured native adapter only. Resolve and freeze full policy identity on admission.

RunSummary.description: Verified execution/restore projection only. Complete does not mean task success, valid grader, natural failure or research eligibility; branchable is not proof of corpus permission or capture success.

reserved_microusd.description: Gross cumulative legacy-compatible reservations, including opening holds. Not invoice spend; may exceed current held plus accounted after evidenced release.

error.description: Safe stored failure envelope with stable persisted originating correlation ID. A 200 poll has its own fresh X-Request-ID. Unknown historical correlation is a persisted migration marker, never a fabricated original request.

Operation.description: Job execution status, not task grade. succeeded can include evaluator success=false. Result run linkage is nullable and authorized before loading; no artifact locator is exposed.
